subject: Customer disputing a transaction, need to cancel it before it goes further
body: We have a customer who is disputing a card transaction and is threatening to raise it with their issuer if we do not sort it out today. I need to cancel the transaction on our side so it does not progress. The payment is pay_3Kd91xR2. Honestly I am not sure exactly what state it is sitting in right now, our internal dashboard just shows it as pending which I do not think maps cleanly onto anything you return. There is also some disagreement here about which version of your API the payments service is actually calling, because the gateway config and the service config do not agree. What call should I be making?
